description: This file contains functions and setup procedures for the MBIM protocol in OpenWRT network configuration, including initialization, setup, teardown, and interaction with the umbim tool for modem communication.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the MBIM protocol configuration parameters.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Extracts specific fields from the MBIM configuration output.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Sets up the MBIM network interface using the configuration.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the MBIM network interface and disconnects the modem.
